findings.passage: “Voter ID is common sense and overwhelmingly supported by a majority of Pennsylvanians. These are the things we are sent here to accomplish, and it’s about time we get it done,” Tomlinson said.
findings.note: Quoted in a joint news release announcing House Bill 771, which would require a voter to show acceptable ID matching the name at the polling place, with a written identity affirmation if the voter has no acceptable ID. Same quote was reprinted by Patch (2025-03-18) and Bucks County Beacon (2025-03-26).
